map.：移除所有非必要空白与换行，得到最小体积的 JSON。: : remove all non-essential whitespace and line breaks to get the smallest possible JSON.
map.：按层级缩进输出（常用 2 空格），便于阅读与 diff。: : emit hierarchical indentation (commonly 2 spaces) for easier reading and diffing.
map.：JSON 要求键与字符串用双引号，不允许尾随逗号与注释。: : JSON requires double quotes for keys and strings and forbids trailing commas and comments.
map.：压缩与美化均不改变数据内容，仅改变排版。: : both minifying and beautifying leave the data unchanged; only the layout differs.
map.移除所有无意义空白与换行，不改变语义: Removes all meaningless whitespace and line breaks without changing semantics
map.常见错误：使用单引号、末尾多余逗号、含注释、数值带前导零——均会导致解析失败。: Common mistakes: single quotes, an extra trailing comma, embedded comments, and numbers with leading zeros — all of these cause parsing to fail.
map.与 json-formatter 同类，去空白压缩。: The same kind of whitespace-removing minification as json-formatter.
map.作为请求体发送，减少传输字节，尤其适合高频调用的内部接口。: without indentation as the request body to cut transmitted bytes, which is especially useful for frequently called internal APIs.
map.多行 JSON 压缩为单行，体积通常降 10–30%。: Multi-line JSON collapses to a single line, typically cutting size by 10–30%.
map.能，合法 JSON 不依赖换行。: Yes. Valid JSON does not depend on line breaks.
map.不会。JSON 规范明确忽略记号之间的空白，键名与字符串值内部的内容不受影响，去: No. The JSON spec explicitly ignores whitespace between tokens, and the contents of keys and string values are unaffected, so the parsed result is identical after removing indentation, line breaks and spaces. The one thing to watch for is accidentally deleting spaces inside a string value when hand-building JSON by concatenation — those belong to the content, not the formatting.
